summary: According to a small computer model rather than human tests, Aminosalicylate Sodium received a medium score of 55 for liver issues and a low score of 16 for heart problems [M]. The drug itself has no listed problems in these records, but some related medications had severe issues [1][2]. A similar drug called Exifone was removed from the French market in 1989 because of liver damage [3]. Another related drug named Sulfacarbamide was taken off the German market in 1988 due to blood issues and liver damage [4].
